page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r5.16xlarge is a memory-optimized instance provisioned on the KVM hypervisor. Powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz, the instance delivers 64 dedicated virtual CPU cores alongside 512.0 GB of system memory. This architecture establishes an 8.0 GB memory-per-core ratio, prioritizing high memory density for environments requiring substantial memory capacity relative to compute resources.

The instance does not include bundled local storage, requiring network-attached block storage for persistent data needs. Network throughput is backed by a 20 Gbps baseline bandwidth, and zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned. From a resource-efficiency perspective, the high RAM-to-vCPU allocation prevents the necessity of over-allocating compute cores merely to satisfy memory footprints, making it efficient for large in-memory caching systems, enterprise relational databases, big data analytics, and memory-bound ETL workflows.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r5.16xlarge is a memory-optimized cloud server built on the KVM hypervisor, featuring 64 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The configuration is equipped with 512.0 GB of memory, yielding a ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per virtual core. Storage is not provided locally, relying instead on network-attached storage options, while baseline network bandwidth reaches 20 Gbps. It contains no discrete GPU accelerators, dedicating all system resources to compute and memory processing. The high memory density ensures qualitative cost efficiency for resource-heavy applications, preventing the need to provision redundant compute cores solely to meet memory capacity requirements. The server is well suited for memory-intensive workloads, including enterprise relational database deployments, in-memory data grids, large-scale caching nodes, data warehousing, and ETL batch jobs.
